create.name: Kerrie Womersley
create.bio:
Kerrie Womersley teaches Qigong and reads the Akashic Records from her home in tropical North Queensland, near Cairns. She set out on a deliberate spiritual path in her late twenties, studying energy work and several traditions before training as a Soul Realignment practitioner and qualifying as an Advanced Holden Qigong teacher in the style of Lee Holden. She is also trained in EFT tapping, which she weaves into her one-to-one work.

Her approach pairs two strands: Akashic readings that look at the soul-level patterns running through a person's life, and gentle daily Qigong that helps that understanding settle into the body and into ordinary routines. She runs an online Qigong membership built around a year-long cycle of monthly themes, offers private readings and longer immersions by video call, and mentors a small number of clients over three months. Locally she holds occasional afternoon Qigong workshops in Cairns. Her book Karma Is the Path sets out her four-stage framework, The Sacred Reclaim, and she shares guided Qigong and meditation recordings on Insight Timer.

courses.title: The Qigong Sanctuary
courses.description: An online Qigong membership that follows a twelve-month cycle of monthly themes, with most guided sessions around twenty minutes. Members also get short routines for daily use and quarterly group gatherings for shared practice. Cancel at any time.

courses.title: Soul Realignment Akashic Readings and Soul-Sight Immersions
courses.description: Private Akashic Records sessions held over video call. The one-hour reading and clearing looks at soul-level gifts and recurring life patterns; the longer immersion adds preparation time, a guided visit to your own Records and a follow-up call three weeks later.

courses.title: The Sacred Reclaim Pathway
courses.description: A three-month private mentorship with fortnightly sessions for people who want to act on what their spiritual practice has shown them. Between meetings Kerrie suggests journaling, tailored Qigong and EFT tapping to help changes take hold.

free_resources.title: Kerrie Womersley on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free guided meditations, Qigong healing-sound practices and short Qigong video classes from Kerrie. A gentle way to try her style before joining her membership.
